```{r}
result <- read_csv("aggregated_results/yearly_prediction_Ahmedabad_hadISD.csv")

head(result)

result |> ggplot(aes(x = year + 2010, y = scaled_b, group = rep)) +
  facet_wrap(~window) +
  geom_line() +
  theme_bw(12)
```
